entities.name: Karel Hendrik van Brederode
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Karel Hendrik van Brederode was a Dutch engineer and architect of railway stations. In 1847 he was cofounder of the Koninklijk Instituut van Ingenieurs in The Hague.
